description: Canonical argument names for driving a sample app from automation. Names are identical on all four platforms; only the delivery mechanism differs. A drawer is for humans, launch arguments are for machines — ship both.

args.name: scenario
args.values: any flow scenario id from scenarios.json

args.name: theme
args.values: any theme scenario id from scenarios.json

args.name: route
args.description: Which entry route hosts the SDK flow. The in-shell route is the one that exposes host-chrome and inset defects; the fullscreen route cannot.

args.name: autostart
args.values: a job type id, or null to stay on the home screen
args.description: Starts a flow immediately on launch, so a flow does not have to tap its way in.

args.name: sandbox
args.description: Environment selection. Automation must never run with sandbox=false — see AGENTS.md.

args.name: appLocale
args.description: In-app locale override. Needed because changing the device locale is not reliably scriptable on every OEM.

args.name: holdCamera
args.description: Host acquires the camera before handing off, to test contention. Verify the host actually acquired it before concluding anything — a probe that never acquired the camera passes vacuously.

mechanisms.android: Intent extras: adb shell am start -e scenario expiredToken -e route shell. Force-stop the app first — starting an already-live task silently ignores new extras and the run proceeds with the previous scenario while looking valid.
mechanisms.ios: Launch arguments read through UserDefaults: app.launchArguments = ["-scenario", "expiredToken"]. XCUITest sets them directly.
mechanisms.flutter: TBD in F2 — must accept the same canonical names.
mechanisms.expo: TBD in F2 — must accept the same canonical names.

openDecisions: Preferred: one cross-platform entry point via a deep link (usesmileidsample://run?scenario=…&route=…), drivable from adb, simctl and a device flow on all four platforms, with the native mechanisms above kept as the platform-specific alternate. Confirm when the first two apps land, then delete this note.
Credentials are seeded as arguments, never typed: keyboard input drops characters from long API keys.
